properties.rule: Head above sea level and not falling. New abstraction up to 150 m3/day (>30 m) or 200 m3/day (>60 m).
Head 0-10 m below sea level. New wells 30-90 m only for non-industrial use, max 60 m3/day; >90 m max 150 m3/day.
Head more than 10 m below sea level. New wells 30-90 m only for non-industrial use, max 40 m3/day; >90 m max 120 m3/day.
No new abstraction; PDAM only, for households and industry. Permit renewals cut at least 15 %; existing wells phased out.
Recharge area: abstraction only for basic daily needs and smallholder farming.
